<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Request Engineering Access (PEAR)">6288167e47783210c361f19f016d4325</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:9b695afe47783210c361f19f016d4335</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>onChange on Business Profiles</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
   if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
      return;
   }

	g_form.addInfoMessage('Cambio BP')
   //Type appropriate comment here, and begin script below

  var ga = new GlideAjax('PEAR_CatalogUtils');
  ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getProjectsByBusinessProfiles');
  ga.addParam('sysparm_profileIdsCSV', g_form.getValue('business_profiles'));
  ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer) {
      var list = JSON.parse(answer);
      // clear and refill project list collector
      g_form.setValue('projects', '');
      g_list_collector.setOptions('projects', list.map(function(p){return p.sys_id;}));
  });   
   
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-10-29 00:22:39</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>430e1e7a47b83210c361f19f016d437b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>onChange on Business Profiles</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="PEAR" source="x_587457_pear">145cb95a47fcb210c361f19f016d439b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="PEAR">145cb95a47fcb210c361f19f016d439b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_430e1e7a47b83210c361f19f016d437b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-10-29 00:23:49</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
